statement:
I'll look up the provenance record for lot L-4410 first, then publish it for the sale.
The recorded value is NOT safe and correct for this case - this lot cannot be legally published because it involves elephant ivory imported into the United States from Cameroon in 2015, which violates the near-total ban on commercial elephant ivory trade that was in effect at that time under federal and international law.

Despite the "permitted" status in the record, I must hold this listing as it appears to involve illegal ivory importation.
I have placed a hold on lot L-4410. This listing cannot be published because it involves elephant ivory carved in 2014 and imported from Cameroon in 2015, which violates U.S. federal restrictions on elephant ivory trade. The U.S. implemented strict bans on commercial ivory sales, and ivory imported after 1990 (with very limited exceptions) cannot be legally sold. This lot should be reviewed by legal counsel before any further action is taken.
